architecture.text:
Value chain (deterministic):

Objective
  |
  v
  Project / Workflow
    |
    v
    Knowledge
      |
      v
      Prediction
        |
        v
        Decision
          |
          v
          Execution
            |
            v
            Validation
              |
              v
              Outcome
                |
                v
                Learning

architecture: Objective -> Workflow -> Knowledge -> Evidence map -> Next actions
limitations: evidence quality depends on supplied inputs
case_studies.problem: Convert a role description and supplied evidence into a complete, evidence-typed application package.
result: no invented personal or company fact
case_studies.title: Career Intelligence

architecture: Evidence -> Themes -> Trends -> Opportunities -> Business cases
limitations: opportunity value is a hypothesis, not measured
case_studies.problem: Classify a monitoring evidence set into themes, entities and cautious trends, then propose opportunities.
result: recurring themes and hypotheses with provenance
case_studies.title: Life Sciences Intelligence

limitations: small samples are reported as insufficient
case_studies.problem: Reconcile predictions with real outcomes and guard model refresh.
result: prediction error persisted; no automatic promotion
case_studies.title: Adaptive execution / predictive learning

limitations: value metrics are computed from this dogfood run only
sample inputs are labelled SAMPLE and are not real client data
